tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind lists, the inbox and settings. Never under a document page.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Document sheets, cards, popovers, the command palette.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, input wells, the empty-state tray and the dropzone at rest.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and around sheets. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, titles, icons on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: correspondent, dates, captions, metadata labels, on all three paper grounds.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only, at 3:1 or better on paper-raised. Never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: archive
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary actions, links, the selected row marker, focus. Text in archive reads on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: archive-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of archive fills and links.

tokens.name: on-archive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an archive fill.

tokens.name: archive-tint
tokens.usage: Selected list row, active sidebar item, highlighted search hit. ink stays the text color on it.

tokens.name: manila
tokens.usage: Folder tabs and the inbox count: the one warm note. ink on it. Use sparingly, at most once per view.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failed processing. Always paired with a word or icon. Reads on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an error notice; danger or ink as text on it.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Processing in progress, needs review. Always paired with a word. Reads on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: pending-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a needs-review notice; pending or ink as text on it.

tokens.name: tag-sage
tokens.usage: Tag fill. ink as text.

tokens.name: tag-slate
tokens.usage: Tag fill. ink as text.

tokens.name: tag-clay
tokens.usage: Tag fill. ink as text.

tokens.name: tag-ochre
tokens.usage: Tag fill. ink as text.

tokens.name: tag-plum
tokens.usage: Tag fill. ink as text.

tokens.name: tag-sky
tokens.usage: Tag fill. ink as text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and onboarding only. One per screen at most.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Document title on the detail view, page titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, card titles, list row titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Folio read 3 pages and found an invoice from Stadtwerke Köln.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in list rows, helper text under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels in the metadata panel and filter bar.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Archive serial numbers, dates, page counts, amounts, file sizes: anything a person might compare across rows.

styles.name: ocr
styles.usage: Extracted OCR text and raw content views.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of the metadata panel; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page regions (header, list, detail).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list row selection.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the command palette. Document sheets stay at radius-sm: paper has sharp-ish corners.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A document page or thumbnail: the only thing that floats at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Command palette, menus, dialogs.
